prompt: "Write a behavior tree for the robot to execute the command using only available nodes. If it finds object, then moves, takes and checks it in order to do a specific task. list of available nodes: <Action ID = FindObject    /> <Action ID = MoveToObject    /> <Action ID = TakeObject    /> <Condition ID = IsObjectHeavy    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectColor    /> <Action ID = CheckObjectMaterial    /> <SubTree ID = SpecificTask    />"
code:
SEQUENCE
		DO FindObject
		DO MoveToObject
		DO TakeObject
	END
